dtype: E4M3 source/weights, FP32 accumulation, BF16 dW
api: TensorRuntime.forward_fp8 accepts BF16 Tensor or rowwise FP8Tensor; backward/backward_async accept either source format on FP8 tapes.
format: E4M3FN contiguous [tokens,hidden], contiguous FP32 dequantization scales [tokens,hidden/128], block_rows=1, positive finite pow2 scales by caller contract. Bare FP8 tensors are rejected.
design: FP8 source branch copies data and scales verbatim into symmetric source packets with copy_source_x. BF16 branch retains prepare_source_x. Both reuse Notify-first streams and source-ready rank publication. No change to GEMM, row-col conversions or AB/Z cache.
method: Same binary for baseline/prequant/baseline_after; 3 models, 8192/20480 nominal tokens per rank, 10 warmups and 30 samples after full trace priming. Benchmark FWD, BWD, and whole cycle separately. Prequantization outside timing, packet copy inside. Weight preparation outside timing. Slowest-rank per-step wall median; bracket baseline uses arithmetic mean of baseline run medians.
checks: Three EP8 model suites plus Qwen35B noncompact mixed BF16/FP8 pool. Compare all outputs exactly for prequantized X-only, dY-only, both, and rank-mixed sources. Reverse-order async BWD, empty source rank, diverse row scales, temporary input ownership, inference on another stream, rejection of bare FP8 and 128x128 source blocks.
limitations: Supplying prequantized input assumes upstream already produced it; this is not a claim that moving the same standalone quantization outside the layer speeds up the full model.
Single-node performance only. No fresh BF16 compute performance comparison.
Raw scale values are not scanned on the host; caller must satisfy the documented pow2/finite/positive contract.
reproduction: Symlink baseline-{model} and baseline_after-{model} to prequant-{model} in build/fp8-prequant-input.

Symlink prequant_after-qwen35b to prequant-qwen35b, then benchmark.py --native-root build/fp8-prequant-input --labels prequant baseline prequant_after baseline_after --models qwen35b --tokens 8192 --mode backward --warmups 10 --samples 30 --output build/fp8-prequant-input/backward-repeat
Run summarize.py on backward-repeat/results.json, then report.py.
conclusion: Retain prequantized-source compatibility. Source preparation kernel median decreases 39-58% at20K, but end-to-end changes are small because Notify already overlaps online quantization. No universal speedup claim. Qwen35B8K BWD initially regressed1.94%; interleaved repeat averaged about0.31% faster, so this regression was not reproduced.
